analysis: The trial succeeded operationally and achieved host validation macro HR@10 of 0.4975: Movies_and_TV 0.585, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.530, Electronics 0.400, and CDs_and_Vinyl 0.475. Equal transition weighting improved the reported recency-weighted result of 0.4963 by 0.0012, but remained 0.0075 below the reported baseline of 0.505. This small single-run difference does not establish that older transitions improve generalization. The intended baseline improvement was not achieved; Electronics had the lowest category HR@10. No test performance was available.
code_summary: Trains one independent SASRec model per category from scratch with seed 42, loading exactly one selected checkpoint per category for prediction. Each network uses 96-dimensional embeddings, two causal attention blocks with two heads, dropout 0.2, normalized item/sequence scoring, a learned scale, and jointly trained item bias. The isolated change replaces exponential recency weights with uniform weights over up to 24 randomly selected valid transitions per history, retaining equal aggregate influence per history through float32 scatter reductions. Sampled-softmax training retains 256 negatives, training-history exclusion masks, prefix augmentation, AdamW, and existing scheduling and checkpoint selection. Dataset routing, supplied splits, trial-local artifacts, and predictor generation remain unchanged; no ensemble or separately fitted scores are used.
